arguments.sql:
SELECT cm.FullName, COUNT(ml.ModelId) AS model_count
FROM model_list ml
JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.FullName
ORDER BY model_count DESC
LIMIT 1
